name: crewdispatch
description: CrewDispatch: dispatch and manage durable long-running coding-agent jobs over a local stdio MCP server.

interface.longDescription: CrewDispatch runs Command Code or WorkBuddy AI coding tasks as durable local jobs and attempts one short terminal notification per job generation. Each job runs in a detached local worker, survives a closed MCP request or an ended client turn, and is cancelled only on an explicit request.
interface.defaultPrompt: Dispatch a coding task with CrewDispatch.
